What is Trump’s “Greater North America” strategy—and why does it matter now? From the Monroe Doctrine to a new “Donroe Doctrine,” this video breaks down a 200-year geopolitical blueprint shaping U.S. actions today. Behind anti-drug operations, military deployments, and regional alliances lies a deeper goal: reclaiming influence in the Western Hemisphere and countering China’s rapid expansion across Latin America—from trade and infrastructure to strategic assets like the Panama Canal. Once you see the pattern, everything starts to connect.
